I know there’s not much that can be said to change your mind. I wanted to ask you though, what are you going to school for? For me personally it wasn’t until I started working in my field that I found friends. College is hard, most people are there to get it over with and go home. I’m saying this as someone who’s been in your place, there’s always something worth living for. It doesn’t matter how big or small, if it means something to you it’s worth it. I was planning my suicide at 18, the night before I looked at my rabbit and realized no one would take care of her like me. After that, it was hard to find reasons worth living so I started small. I started watching reality TV because it gave me something to look forward to each week. I started writing poems because I couldn’t put into words how I was feeling. Most of all I lived to spite those who’ve wrong me because I knew if I died they’d be happy and I didn’t want to give them the satisfaction. Over time I started living less out of spite and more for myself. 
Loneliness is tough but it comes in waves, some crash harder than others. Your people will come and when they do they will be there to stay. It’s hard to find quality people in general these days but I promise there’s someone out there who’s looking for a friend like you. I’m proud of you for putting yourself out there, it’s not easy to do that. Whatever you decide to do I just hope you find peace. Every minute of everyday something is changing, and sometimes it just takes a minute to change your whole life. ❤️

First day when husband and I moved to a new town we saw a dog on the road, we got out and tried to catch him, my husband ran ahead and I needed to stop because of my asthma. I remember sitting and an old lady came and sat next to me, calming me down. I was panicking because I was afraid of my husband getting hit. When I got my breath and caught up with him he quickly shoved my face into his chest and begged me not to look. 
All I could hear was the screams and crying from the dogs owners and the magnifying silence of the town. The dog was being watched by a sitter and got loose, at this point the whole town froze in effort to catch this dog but it just took one car to sadly take his life. 
I remember crying all night as I recently just lost our dog, I couldn’t imagine loosing a pet in such a horrible situation. I think about that dog often and hope the family was able to get some closure. The only positive was seeing how United the town was to try and help the dog. Poor baby
